identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Persist provenance for title-only issue updates

values.summary: Approve the narrow owner design, bind, implement marker-aware title-only update and exact readback, validate, obtain fresh review, and stop before merge.

steps.action: Finalize the title-only provenance contract: durable operation-key-to-request fingerprint receipts, same-key idempotent retry, conflicting key reuse fail-closed, and compatibility with legacy body-bearing markers.

Implement only csdlc-v2/src/github.rs plus focused gate_github_actions coverage for body preservation, provenance readback, retry, conflicting reuse, partial-operation recovery, and deterministic concurrent body drift boundaries.
Run focused validation and strict Clippy, obtain fresh exact-head review with no unresolved findings, publish ready, and stop before merge.

invariants: No existing issue body bytes are removed
Title equality alone is insufficient reconciliation proof
risks: Unnecessary body update may affect formatting
stop_conditions: Focused proof or exact-head review fails
